content.value_statement: Teams often waste strong creator posts because they lack a clear paid or repurposing plan. This skill turns approved UGC into scored media choices, reuse maps, and launch-ready distribution plans.
actual_capabilities: Scores creator posts for paid amplification using organic performance, hook quality, message clarity, production quality, and CTA strength.
Builds paid media plans for whitelisting, Spark Ads, brand boosting, and dark posts.
Allocates campaign budgets by content, platform, objective, pacing phase, and testing reserve.
Creates UGC repurposing maps that turn one approved asset into multiple channel-specific formats.
Tracks usage rights, expiration dates, approved channels, and rights expansion opportunities.
Produces optimization playbooks with KPI targets, scale rules, pause rules, and creative refresh triggers.
limitations: It does not approve content for brand safety, FTC disclosure, or claim accuracy.
It needs user-provided metrics or optional connectors for measured reach, engagement, CPM, CPC, and ROAS.
It plans transformations but does not edit video, images, audio, or design files directly.
It should not recommend paid, website, or email reuse when rights are unknown or organic only.

use_cases.title: Choose Posts to Boost
use_cases.description: Rank campaign posts, identify top paid candidates, and assign spend by creator, platform, and objective.

use_cases.title: Turn UGC Into Channel Assets
use_cases.description: Convert approved creator videos into ads, reels, website proof, email assets, quote cards, and sales materials.

use_cases.title: Prepare Paid Creator Campaigns
use_cases.description: Plan Spark Ads, Partnership Ads, targeting, budget pacing, KPI checks, and scale or pause rules.

prompt_templates.title: Pick Content to Amplify
prompt_templates.prompt: Use paid mode. We have approved creator posts from [campaign]. Rank which posts to boost using [budget], [platforms], and these metrics: [metrics].

prompt_templates.title: Build a UGC Repurposing Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Use repurpose mode. We have [number] approved creator assets with these rights: [rights]. Map each asset into paid, website, email, and organic formats.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Spark Ads and Whitelisting
prompt_templates.prompt: Use paid mode. Create a Spark Ads and Partnership Ads plan for [campaign]. Include content tiers, authorization needs, targeting, budget splits, and optimization rules.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Full Reuse System
prompt_templates.prompt: Use repurpose mode. Build a rights-tracked UGC library plan, naming convention, 30-day distribution calendar, and rights expansion list for [asset set].

output_examples.input: Five TikTok posts, a 5,000 dollar budget, and basic view and engagement metrics.
output_examples.output: A ranked amplification scorecard, recommended spend per creator, Spark Ads setup priorities, and a three-day learning phase plan.

output_examples.input: Three approved creator videos with twelve-month paid and website usage rights.
output_examples.output: A repurposing map with short-form clips, quote cards, website embeds, email assets, paid variants, and a dated rollout calendar.

output_examples.input: A mixed UGC library with full, limited, and organic-only rights.
output_examples.output: A rights tracker that separates usable assets from restricted assets and lists renewal or upgrade opportunities.

best_practices: Provide source metrics, budget, campaign objective, platform priorities, and rights status before requesting the plan.
Label estimated performance numbers clearly when measured ad or organic data is unavailable.
Run content review and rights checks before using any creator asset in paid, website, or email placements.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to approve claims, disclosures, or legal compliance.
Do not ask it to boost every post without ranking performance and creative fit first.
Do not reuse creator assets across paid or owned channels when usage rights are missing or restricted.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs approved creator assets, platform details, performance metrics, usage rights, budget, objectives, and target channels.

faq.question: Can it choose which influencer posts to boost?
faq.answer: Yes. It scores each candidate and recommends amplification tiers with spend suggestions.

faq.question: Does it create finished video or image assets?
faq.answer: No. It specifies the needed formats, edits, crops, lengths, and channel uses for production teams.

faq.question: Does it verify FTC disclosure or claim compliance?
faq.answer: No. It explicitly hands those checks to a content review or legal review workflow before amplification.

faq.question: Can it plan Spark Ads or Partnership Ads?
faq.answer: Yes. It outlines authorization needs, campaign setup, targeting, budget splits, and optimization rules.

faq.question: Can it work without ad platform connectors?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use pasted metrics and clearly mark missing or estimated values.
